name: Timothy Patridge
title: Growth and Expansion Specialist
bio: Tim is a Business Development Manager at Connect Group. Seeking out new business opportunities for the company by building and Maintaining Relationships with partnerships/connections both locally and internationally. Tim has a background in Logistics, working in the UK for a number of years at large Organizations.
